name: diff-explorer
description: A VS Code-style side panel for the files Claude changes: a file tree with Material-style icons and a GitHub-dark diff preview. /diffs opens it.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd: Material-style file icons drawn with Nerd Font glyphs (needs a Nerd Font in the terminal). plain: colored dots, works with any font.

autoOpen.title: Open on first change
autoOpen.description: Open the panel beside the chat the first time Claude changes a file in a session (only where it would dock as a sidebar).
